what_this_is_en: Review items that come from the PICTURES in the patent rather than from its words. Two kinds. First, every place the patent's own drawing and the patent's own text disagree - these are defects in the patent, and the question put to the reviewer is whether we recorded the contradiction faithfully instead of tidying it away. Second, every place the structure we recorded and the structure the patent drew are not the same molecule - these are defects in the extraction.

summary.structure_cross_checks_note_en: A cross-check runs only where our record was chosen by the compound name in the patent's text rather than by the drawing, because only then can the two readings genuinely disagree.

comparisons.crop_confidence_en: HOW THE PICTURE ABOVE WAS FOUND: automatically. This page holds 1 such block, and reading the page found 1 drawing, so the two agree. The cut is deliberately loose. If it has sliced a molecule in half, or shows a different molecule from the one named above, this comparison is broken and should be reported as broken rather than answered.

Two different polymorphs cannot have identical powder patterns, so one of the two tables is almost certainly wrong in the published patent.
